name: Mark Burton
office: City of Manhattan Beach, Member of the City Council

items.text: Mark Burton is a former Manhattan Beach mayor and councilmember and a former Los Angeles senior assistant city attorney.

sentences.text: Mark Burton is a former Manhattan Beach mayor and councilmember and a former Los Angeles senior assistant city attorney.

items.text: His campaign lists prior support for open government measures, a school district use agreement, a short-term rental ban, and police hiring and license plate readers. He cites a projected $10.9 million fiscal 2027 deficit to urge spending discipline. He told MB Weekly he would move to freeze hiring and promotions, except in public safety, until full-time staffing drops from 357 to 290, and seek 10% spending cut options from each department. His campaign says he opposes high-rise development on commercial corridors and supports a two-term council limit. He says he voted against the FY 2016-17 and FY 2017-18 operating budget.
